children: LS Electric's 3Q earnings are likely to meet market expectations, Nomura's Eon Hwang and YJ Kim say. Earnings growth at the South Korean electrical-equipment supplier is expected to continue, driven by an improved product mix and strong demand for transformers, the analysts write in a note. They expect the company's operating profit to jump 86.5% to 188 billion won for the July-September period, largely in line with the consensus estimate of 185 billion won. They value the stock at a premium, noting the increased use of on-site generators at artificial-intelligence data centers as power-grid connection delays persist. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
